claims.rationale: Every listed result is bounded to a persisted repair-candidate receipt and two exact hosted failure observations; a successful repaired hosted canary, agent execution, draft publication, remote CI for this repair, public installation, Claude activation, and release remain separate gates.
claims.statement: On this Windows host, the local v0.8.1 repair candidate ran 230 repository tests: 229 passed and one privilege-dependent generic symlink test was skipped. It passed the official skill validator and repository plugin contract tests, replayed the offline quality-loop conformance fixture without outbound action, and verified its package and embedded engine. The tests cover the closed managed-fleet policy, deterministic thin caller, explicit reusable-workflow SHA binding, expiring configuration-only authorizations, protected-environment workflow structure, privilege separation, and documentation surfaces. Two hosted dry runs stopped fail-closed before agent execution or repository writes; successful repaired hosted execution remains unobserved.

evidence_items.observed_summary: The persisted receipt records 230 repository tests run on Windows: 229 passed and one privilege-dependent generic symlink test was skipped.

The offline conformance fixture committed one local proposal, deduplicated replay, and performed no outbound action.

Two hosted method dry runs stopped fail-closed before agent execution or repository writes: the first on caller-versus-central workflow identity and the second on a missing configuration-only authorization expiry.
